title: PurchaseValueScore
description: One row of fct_purchase_value_score: the purchase-time conditional value of one purchase. Estimand: E[gross_profit_90d | purchase], the expected gross profit of the purchase's user over the 90 days from occurred_at (this purchase included), given the purchase and only what was known at occurred_at. This is the value sent to ad platforms with the purchase, by the server and by the browser pixel. It is not PredictedProfit, which is the unconditional per-exposed-user estimate for experiment readouts. All money fields are in `currency`, major units. Enforced by validators.ts (zod), not expressible here: event_id = purchase_<invoice_id> (or purchase_<checkoutSessionId> when invoice_id is null); scored_at >= occurred_at; predicted_profit_90d = predicted_revenue_90d - predicted_generation_cost_90d - predicted_fees_90d - predicted_refund_risk (within 0.01); interval_low <= predicted_profit_90d <= interval_high; features_snapshot.as_of and every *_at feature <= occurred_at.

event_id.description: The purchase's ledger event_id: purchase_<invoiceId>, or purchase_<checkoutSessionId> for an invoice-less one-time pack.

scored_at.description: When the score was computed; >= occurred_at.

predicted_generation_cost_90d.description: Vendor cost of the predicted credit burn.

predicted_refund_risk.description: Expected refund + chargeback loss (money, not a probability).

predicted_profit_90d.description: Point estimate of the estimand. May be negative.

interval_low.description: Lower bound of the model's uncertainty interval for the estimand.

interval_high.description: Upper bound of the model's uncertainty interval for the estimand.

cash_value.description: This purchase's cash (amount paid), converted to `currency`.

run_id.description: The scoring run that produced this row.

fitted_params_ref.description: Where the fitted parameters live (URI or table@version).

features_snapshot.description: Point-in-time features used for the score (flat scalars). as_of is the feature cut-off and must be <= occurred_at.
